fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company expects to consume approximately 2 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2016.

instrument_type_details.notes: Per Note 10: primarily uses a mixture of purchased call options, collar structures, call spreads, put spreads, and fixed price swap agreements. Portfolio covers 2016-2018. Net fair value at 12/31/2015 was a net liability of $1.481 billion (2016: -$863M, 2017: -$630M, 2018: +$12M). Cash collateral deposits provided: $835M cash + $250M aircraft collateral. Over 1,200 separate financial derivative instruments.

warnings: 2016 pct_hedged (20%) is the average at current Brent prices as of Jan 15, 2016; Note 10 states 'up to 63%' maximum for 2016. MD&A table uses 'Approx. 20%' as average.
Note 10 gallon volumes are maximum economic hedge and may vary significantly as market prices fluctuate.
First quarter 2016 shown as effectively unhedged (0%) at current price levels in MD&A table.
All volume figures are in gallons (millions) as required.
